content.about: Lebanon is a small, mountainous country on the eastern Mediterranean coast. Its snowy peaks once held great cedar forests, and a cedar tree is on its flag. Ancient Phoenician cities like Byblos and Tyre were trading powers. Lebanese food, with dishes like tabbouleh and hummus, is loved across the world.

standout.text: The cedars of Lebanon are among the oldest trees mentioned in historical records.

didYouKnow: Byblos is one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world.
You can ski and swim in the sea on the same day in spring.
The Phoenician alphabet, developed here, is an ancestor of many modern alphabets.
